## What does this PR do?
Adds a dated Nemotron 3.5 Super VL release announcement to the README News section.

## Changelog
- Summarize checkpoint conversion, image inference, training recipes, and text-only workflows.
- Link the model documentation and verification card for verified configurations and limitations.
- No implementation or verification-record changes.

## GitHub Actions CI
All-file pre-commit and git diff --check passed. Both relative link targets exist. Independent review completed; wording was narrowed to avoid implying verified video inference. Runtime tests are not applicable to this README-only change.

## Before your PR is Ready for review
- [x] Followed contributor guidelines.
- [x] Updated documentation.
- [x] Checked links and reviewed claims against documentation/card.
- [ ] Optional-component changes (not applicable).

## Additional Information
Follows the publication restoration in #6482.

files.patch: @@ -11,6 +11,9 @@ ## 📣 News + +- [10/15/2026] **NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is released!** Megatron Bridge supports the 120B-A12B vision-language model with HF↔Megatron checkpoint conversion, image inference, and pretraining, SFT, and LoRA recipes, plus text-only conversion and training workflows. See the [model documentation](docs/models/nemotron/nemotron3.5-super-vl.md) and [verification card](examples/model_verification_cards/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b/card.yaml) for supported workflows, verified configurations, and current limitations. + - [10/15/2026] [**Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B**](examples/models/muse_spark_open/README.md) is now supported! Megatron Bridge adds checkpoint conversion, inference, and GB200 training recipes for the 816B-total / 42B-active vision-and-audio-language MoE model: pretraining, full SFT, long-context SFT at 32K and 64K with context parallelism, LoRA, and image-text SFT and LoRA, with HybridEP MoE dispatch. See the [examples README](examples/models/muse_spark_open/README.md) and the [verification card](examples/model_verification_cards/muse-spark-open-816b-a42b/card.yaml) for details. - [08/19/2026] **Megatron Bridge 0.6.0 released!** Highlights include GLM-5.2 with cuDNN fused DSA for 128K THD-packed context-parallel training, new LLM/VLM/diffusion models, more reliable VLM data and sequence packing, improved checkpoint and LoRA workflows, unified training and conversion launchers, and refreshed performance recipes. Huge thanks to our community contributors! See the [full release notes](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/releases/tag/v0.6.0).
